newsitem.title: GERMANY: German call money steady around 3.10 percent.
newsitem.headline: German call money steady around 3.10 percent.

text.p: German overnight call rates were steady on Tuesday around 3.10 percent with traders finding ample funds as the month-end nears.
Money traders said, however, that the risk of tight conditions may prompt the Bundesbank to make a net injection of around 1.5 billion marks on Wednesday when 74.9 billion marks of repos mature.
But traders said the central bank will be careful not to steer rates too low and that it wants call rates to remain above three percent.
Credit institutions held 42.4 billion marks witht he Bundesbank on Monday, up from 41.7 billion marks the day before. The average for the month so far stands at 40.4 billion marks.
No significant amount of funds was borrowed from the Lombard emergency lending facility.
The Frankfurt Interbank Overnight Average stood at 3.12967 percent compared with 3.13775 percent.
